open_crosscheck.reason: Closest open, repository-packaged cross-check to the paper-native FP-LAPW methodology.

fallback.reason: Useful independent methodology, but less method-matched than an all-electron LAPW cross-check.

execution_policy: Do not install or execute a competing DFT backend while the active Palace workload is consuming the Lenovo solver resources. Prefer /var/tmp or another non-home work area once cleared.
claim_boundary: Backend selection is an engineering decision only; it is not a DFT result.
